title: AI, Fair Housing, and the Homebuying Process
discussion_signal: The post frames AI homebuying tools as both a source of speed and a civil-rights risk, emphasizing fair lending, algorithmic bias, and the continued role of professionals. It provides a consumer-facing counter-signal to the idea that digital convenience automatically produces fair or usable access.
linked_research_question: How do housing professionals interpret AI-assisted homebuying as a tradeoff between convenience, privacy, fair lending, human oversight, and civil-rights protection?
limits: The post cites secondary survey claims rather than the GAO report directly
No outcome or discrimination audit is presented
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
